download_laser2_models: run the python module to download LASER2 sentence encoder model files to the cache directory
download_laser3_models: run the python module to download LASER3 sentence encoder model files for a specific language
download_single_file: run the LaserModelDownloader class download method to fetch a single model file from the LASER S3 bucket
get_language_code: run the get_language_code method to resolve a FLORES200 language name to its LASER model code
run_cli_download: run the python module with argparse flags --laser --lang --spm --model-dir to download LASER models
